column1: # mapping_set_title: CDIF small-angle scattering concepts to NeXus NXsas
# comment: Written as the second binding onto the concept hub, to test the
#   claim that adding a technique is a crosswalk rather than a code change.
#   See docs/NXsas.md for what NXsas is and how real files depart from it.
#   Two namespaces appear as subjects, deliberately.
#   cdifsas: is minted here for concepts specific to small-angle
#   scattering -- there is no CDIF SAS glossary yet, so these follow the
#   w3id mint-now-redirect-later pattern the XAS concepts used.
#   cdifxas: appears for four concepts that are NOT XAS concepts at all:
#   the facility, the beamline, the radiation probe and the source type.
#   They are properties of any synchrotron or reactor measurement, and
#   SSSOM identifies concepts rather than namespaces, so re-minting them
#   under cdifsas: would assert that a SAS facility and a XAS facility
#   are different things. They are not. That they currently sit in an
#   XAS-flavoured namespace is an accident of which crosswalk was written
#   first, and writing this second one is what exposed it: these belong
#   in a technique-neutral namespace, and moving them is a change to the
#   XAS glossary rather than something to paper over here.
#   Q is not mapped, because a raw NXsas file does not contain it. The
#   scattering vector is computed from wavelength, detector distance,
#   beam centre and pixel size -- which is why those scalars are part of
#   the data description here rather than mere context.
